bump_motion_and_inertia.description: Motion and downstream inertia calculated from the specified bump polynomial.

inertial_controller_reference_comparison.scope: Rigid attachments; equal clean/three-seed light and heavy endpoint cohorts, not finite-cell qualification.

inertial_PI_reference_gain_search.scope: 72 completed native rigid-reference recordings; eight common cases per gain pair.

inertial_cell_stiffness_sensitivity.scope: Six common cases per stiffness/controller: finite undamped cell, upper rigid, sharp bump, no preview. Star is a separate six-case filtered-FF study; not a complete retuned stiffness grid.

inertial_performance_limit_decomposition.scope: Exact decomposition of five retained native four-second v7 histories; zero new simulations. Each source is its controller's worst endpoint trace, so seeds may differ across rows. Physical truth is diagnostic only.
inertial_performance_limit_decomposition.qualification: Diagnostic force-balance decomposition, not extra simulations or equal-seed qualification. All five traces have zero voltage and effort clipping.

screw_pitch_inertia_and_heating.scope: Analytical RE25 winding sizing, total rotating J1.58e-6kgm2,50N, no guide losses;90percent efficiency only a conservative sizing bound
screw_pitch_inertia_and_heating.qualification: RE25 26.3mNm at 3mm lead and 90% motoring sizing gives 49.574597 N before guide loss; passing continuous current alone does not establish 50N continuous.

inertial_mechanics_spring_tuning.scope: Selected lower spring/damper controller search and repeated-bump reference; retained original native recordings, not additional simulations.

inertial_mechanics_selected_repeated.scope: Selected lower spring/damper controller search and repeated-bump reference; retained original native recordings, not additional simulations.

inertial_mechanics_selected_bump_overlay.scope: Selected lower spring/damper controller search and repeated-bump reference; retained original native recordings, not additional simulations.

inertial_final_current_response.scope: S = 2 kg, B = 0.6 kg, target 50 N, fixed 90 degrees, Coulomb drag coefficient 0.3; seven repeated 1 mm high, 10 mm wide bumps at 100 mm/s during 10 s; noise seeds 7 and 1729. Only configured inner current response and ideal available bus vary. It is not a full-range or hardware qualification.
inertial_final_current_response.springMetadataScope: The response probe used the prior 18.1 mm spring metadata, actual 33.6 N preload and unchanged 19,746 N/m plus 60 N s/m physical link. Final 20 mm approximate metadata is a separate force-identical candidate with its own packing audit; these probe packing lengths must not be relabeled.
inertial_final_current_response.qualification: 100µs is the final grid target.50µs and150µs are bounded alternatives; model bandwidth is not measured driver capability.

inertial_mechanics_v8_actual_tolerance.scope: 72 actual-k/c native recordings with fixed nominal controller;20mm packing analytically rescored, no new force runs.

inertial_uncertainty_v8_sensing.scope: 42 final-acquisition sensing OAT native records; separate from joint allowance.

inertial_uncertainty_v8_joint.scope: 60 final-acquisition26-dimensional deterministic corners at two endpoints, three seeds; not exhaustive error box.

inertial_final_voltage_headroom.scope: 16 final-source native electrical records/15distinct conditions; steady linear-stage heat is an analytical calculation.

inertial_final_range_coverage.scope: Finite nominal sharp-bump grid, exact known mass/tare, fixed orientations and Coulomb drag coefficients; every recorded native sample is scored. This is not hardware qualification or an uncertainty guarantee.

inertial_final_worst_native.scope: Finite nominal sharp-bump grid, exact known mass/tare, fixed orientations and Coulomb drag coefficients; every recorded native sample is scored. This is not hardware qualification or an uncertainty guarantee.
inertial_final_worst_native.plotScope: All native samples in the displayed bump window; complete history determines the reported metric.
